title: New Staff Member sets Technician again when Time Clock changes
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Start on Settings, Staff.
custom_steps:
1. Open the New Staff Member window.
  2. In Role, pick "Technician".
  3. If Time Clock is off, switch it on.
  4. Switch Time Clock off.
  5. Switch Time Clock on.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Staff Member window opens.

Step 2:

  • Role shows Technician.

Step 3:

  • Time Clock is on.
  • Technician is on.

Step 4:

  • Technician switches off and is grayed out.

Step 5:

  • Technician switches on again by itself.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 18 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11879 (Story 1, Technician toggle on a staff member)

  • S1-R3: “In the New Staff Member window, Technician is pre-filled from the role shown: on when the role is the built-in Technician or the built-in Foreman role and Time Clock is on, otherwise off. Every other role pre-fills off, including Parts Technician and every custom role, even one made from Technician or Foreman. The pre-fill runs when the window opens and again each time the role or Time Clock is changed, until the user switches Technician by hand. From then on the user's choice wins: changing the role or Time Clock no longer pre-fills it, though S1-R4 and S1-N1 still turn it off, and only the user turns it back on. The toggle as shown is what is saved. Save & Add Next clears the form as it does today (no role, Time Clock off, Technician off) and forgets any earlier switch by hand, so the next person is pre-filled from their own role. Edit Staff Member never pre-fills (S1-E1).”
  • S1-R4: “Technician can only be on while Time Clock is on. While Time Clock is off, the Technician toggle is off and grayed out, and hovering it shows "Turn on Time Clock first. Only staff who clock in can be technicians." Turning Time Clock off, in the window or any other way (for example through the Public API), turns Technician off.”
  • S1-R5: “In Edit Staff Member, turning Time Clock back on leaves Technician off; the user turns it on. In New Staff Member, turning Time Clock on pre-fills Technician from the role (S1-R3), unless the user has already switched Technician by hand.”

From: Chris Ward's answers, Google Sheet "Technician Toggle – questions for Chris Ward (2 Nov 2026)", https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1nLKkgSgmtqCYu4eu15_9xN38ml32tDnJls42PPq_A4M, column E, answered 2 Nov 2026 (po-answers-2026-11-02/ANSWERS-Chris-Ward-2026-11-02.md), read 2 Nov 2026

  • Answer 5 (question 5): “5. (a) As the PRD says: in New Staff Member it switches back on from the role, unless the user already switched Technician by hand. The page 3 note in the design was written before the pre-fill existed, and I'll fix it. In Edit Staff Member, turning Time Clock back on still leaves Technician off.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793640819-ff4d, read 2 Nov 2026: page "3 When Technician can't be turned on", picture "Time Clock off" (This build); page "2 Turn Technician on for a staff member", picture "Technician role picked" (This build)

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p3-01-after-time-clock-off.png
  • tt-p2-03-after-technician-role-picked.png

The design's own words:

  • “Technician needs Time Clock. While Time Clock is off, Technician is off and grayed out. Tooltip, verbatim: "Turn on Time Clock first. Only staff who clock in can be technicians."”
  • “Turning Time Clock off turns Technician off. Turning Time Clock back on: in New Staff Member, Technician is set from the role again (on for the built-in Technician or Foreman role), unless the user already switched it by hand (page 2); in Edit Staff Member it stays off and the user turns it on.”
  • “Time Clock on and the built-in Technician role picked: Technician switches on by itself. The built-in Foreman role does the same; every other role, including Parts Technician and custom roles, leaves it off.”
  • “Changing the role or Time Clock sets it again from the role, until the user switches Technician by hand: from then on their choice wins. Edit Staff Member never does this.”

Ruled: Chris answered question 5 (a), as the PRD: New Staff Member sets Technician again from the role; the design's page 3 note now says the same (register TT-D01, PO-RULED).
